# External

## Purpose

Defines the externally sourced reference data area for BAYA ML research.

## Responsibilities

Plans licensed or permitted external Baybayin-related data with provenance, usage constraints, and version notes.

## Allowed Contents

Future governed materials specifically supporting externally sourced reference data, with provenance and version information where applicable.

## Excluded Contents

Operational application data, credentials, unrelated experiment outputs, and production artifacts without approval.

## Dependencies

Must identify relevant upstream dataset, preprocessing, configuration, algorithm, or artifact versions according to its lifecycle position.

## Related BAYA Requirements

Supports comparative handwriting evaluation and reproducible thesis research.

## Future Implementation Notes

External sources must remain distinguishable from BAYA-collected data. No model files or datasets are created now.
